survivor_root.title: Survivor
survivor_root.description: Starting point of the skill tree. Unlock this node first, then choose among Mobility, Exploration & Scavenging, Combat and Engineering.

description.text: Maximum available in this skill tree:
Maximum available in this skill tree:
Up to 28% arrow or CGM ammo recovery on creature hits
Maximum available in this skill tree:
Maximum available in this skill tree:
loot, maps and field utility unlocks
Each node adds +6% chance to completely negate fall damage (up to 30%).
Each node grants +5% sprint speed (up to 45%).
Each node increases movement speed while crouching by 10% (up to 40%). Crouching remains slower than normal walking.
Each node reduces exhaustion generated by all activities by 7% (up to 35%).
Allows use of standard and motorized Grappling Hooks. Ender equipment requires the Ender Traversal specialization.
Unlocks sprinting, vaulting, sliding, crawling, diving, fast swimming, safe landing, pole climbing, wall slide, wall jump and wall running in ParCool.
Hostile mobs acquire you only at 65% of their normal detection distance. Close enemies can still notice and pursue you.
Press Jump again while airborne to perform a second jump. The ability has a 30-second cooldown.
Allows riding Alex's Mobs mounts after their normal taming or equipment requirements are met.
After taking damage, gain +25% movement speed for 5 seconds. 30-second cooldown. Shared intermediate Mobility milestone.
Adds a 3% chance per node to preserve one common component used in the Custom Workbench; maximum 24%.
Increases block breaking speed with the correct tool by 10% per node; maximum 60%.
Each node adds 0.3 blocks of interaction reach; maximum +1.5 blocks.
Each node adds 10% chance for tools, weapons and armor to avoid durability loss.
Increases durability restored by repair kits by 7.5% per node; maximum 30%.
Unlocks Create kinetic sources, shafts, cogs, belts and basic transmission components.
Unlocks the Basic Turret and raises your global turret capacity to 1.
Advanced structural knowledge required before choosing a final Engineering specialization.
Unlocks advanced Create components required before choosing Create Automation.
Unlocks Auto and Shotgun Turrets and raises your global turret capacity to 2.
Shows nearby passive food animals on Advanced Compass at 9, 18, 27 or 33 blocks across four nodes.
Each node adds +2% chance for one extra raw ore from eligible ore blocks; maximum 10%.
Reduces merchant prices by 4% per node; maximum 16%.
Each node adds +2.5% chance for one extra Sweet Berry when gathering a wild bush; player-planted bushes do not qualify. Maximum 22.5% across nine nodes.

Each node adds +3% chance for one extra eligible stackable item the first time generated loot is opened, plus +0.5 Luck. Locked reward chests, artifacts, keys and weapons are excluded. Maximum 15% and +2.5 Luck.
Ore blocks within 20 blocks glow at light level 8 of 15.
Allows placing and using the Recycler to recover part of the base materials from damaged or unwanted equipment.
Fells a whole tree when its lowest log is broken with an axe. This intermediate milestone leads to the Scavenging specializations.
Allows equipping and opening the Quark Backpack.
Raises eligible mob key drops to 6% / 8% / 18% / 32% by threat level, and improves Fallen Adventurer key chances.
Adds 60 seconds to damage resistance, regeneration and infection immunity received after respawning from death.
Each node grants +2% projectile damage, including compatible firearms.

Each node adds +7% chance to recover an ordinary arrow or CGM ammunition fired into a creature; maximum 28%. Arrow retrieval works by approaching the creature or collecting it after death. Firearm ammunition returns to your inventory. Special arrows, Infinity and piercing arrows are excluded.
Adds 2 blocks of reach when attacking or interacting with entities. Shared intermediate Combat milestone.

Adds a fixed 30% chance to recover one ordinary arrow lodged in a monster after that monster dies. Separate from the four Arrow Retrieval nodes; no firearms, special arrows, Infinity or piercing arrows.
Common Golden Apples restore 2 permanently lost hearts instead of 1. Shared intermediate milestone.
Shows hostile monsters within 10 blocks on Advanced Compass. Also warns with a heartbeat and screen pulse when an Elite or Boss targets you.
Extends hostile-monster detection on Advanced Compass to 30 blocks. Keeps the Elite and Boss aggro warning from Threat Sense I.
Increases ranged damage by 25%, including bows, crossbows and compatible firearms. Shared intermediate Combat milestone.
At 20% health or lower, gain +20% movement speed and unlimited ParCool stamina for 15 seconds. 3-minute cooldown. Your first Mobility specialization opens the other Mobility paths.
Completely prevents one instance of fall damage, then enters a 30-second cooldown. Your first Mobility specialization opens the other Mobility paths.
Allows use of the Ender Staff and Ender Grappling Hook. Your first Mobility specialization opens the other Mobility paths.
After 20 seconds without taking damage, restores 4 health (2 hearts) every 45 seconds. Your first Combat specialization opens the other Combat paths.
At 20% health or lower, gain Resistance I for 60 seconds. 5-minute cooldown. Your first Combat specialization opens the other Combat paths.
Killing a hostile mob restores 2 health over 4 seconds. 10-second cooldown. Your first Combat specialization opens the other Combat paths.
When unlocking a chest, has a 30% absolute chance to preserve the required key. Your first Scavenging specialization opens the other Scavenging paths.
Sneak and right-click into the air with a torch in your main hand to consume it and gain 10 seconds of Night Vision. Stack up to 6 charges (60 seconds).
Improves Workbench dismantling efficiency while still excluding rare components. Your first Scavenging specialization opens the other Scavenging paths.
Unlocks Create automatic assembly, logistics, trains and advanced production systems.
Allows placing Smooth Stone as a permanent fortification that Enhanced AI miners cannot break.
Unlocks the Explosive Turret, advanced turret modules and raises global turret capacity to 3. Explosive Turrets consume 2 capacity.
Requires Ore Sense I. Removes the distance limit: loaded ore blocks glow wherever they are visible.
